comment: It may be valuable to establish a minimum cross-scheme reconciliation requirement linking country-specific Contract and Benefits Management Systems (CBMS) with the shared Client Registry identity. The draft provides a useful description of the relationship between the Benefits Package Registry, Beneficiary Registry and CBMS, including the importance of reliable enrolment records for identifying duplicate enrolment and potential fraud. Given that CBMS implementations are country-specific, a minimum interoperability expectation could help ensure consistent safeguards across different health schemes. For example, a requirement for country-specific CBMS implementations to reconcile enrolments and claims against the shared Client Registry identity could provide a common baseline for detecting duplicate enrolment and supporting appropriate fraud-prevention processes.
